findings.trigger: Run the T13 gate; command 4 is npm install --prefix packages/api-client --no-package-lock --no-audit --no-fund && npm run typecheck --prefix packages/api-client.
findings.impact: No package-lock.json is committed and the install is explicitly told not to create one, so the typecheck resolves TypeScript 5.6.3 from the public registry without an integrity pin. package.json pins the exact compiler version and the command fails closed, so this is a hermeticity/reproducibility gap, not a correctness gap. Known and accepted as a V0 advisory; unchanged by this delta.
findings.required_fix: Commit a lockfile and use npm ci, or record the registry dependency explicitly. Not required for attempt-3 acceptance.

findings.trigger: Inspect the T13 write boundary against fix commit 7957ba5's change to scripts/run_gateway.py (import at line 41, validation around line 73).
findings.impact: The file is outside the recorded T13 boundary/FILE_LOCKS and the extension is recorded only in the tasklog. The change is small and covered by test_deployment_retention, but the lock protocol requires the Supervisor to record the extension. Known and accepted as a V0 advisory; unchanged by this delta.
findings.required_fix: Record scripts/run_gateway.py in the T13 boundary or an explicit Supervisor authorization at integration. Not required for attempt-3 acceptance.

findings.trigger: Construct V1Client to call POST /v1/auth/login or /v1/auth/refresh before any token exists.
findings.impact: ClientOptions.token is required and call() always sends Authorization: Bearer, so the generated client cannot represent an unauthenticated call without a placeholder token. Login works because the route does not require the header; this is API ergonomics, not a security or functional failure. Known and accepted as a V0 advisory; unchanged by this delta.
findings.required_fix: Make the token optional and omit the Authorization header when absent; regenerate and re-check byte identity and typecheck. Not required for attempt-3 acceptance.

findings.trigger: Inspect commit d69b992 on the T13 branch.
findings.impact: d69b992 sets T12's status to DONE in addition to adding the T13 probe-coverage nodeid. T12's status is the Supervisor's integration record; the attempt-2 tasklog asserts Supervisor authorization but no FILE_LOCKS or PROGRESS record in the tree documents it. This is carried forward unchanged from reviews 1/2 and requires Supervisor bookkeeping, not a T13 code fix.
findings.required_fix: Supervisor explicitly confirms the T12 status carry-over at integration, or reverts the T12 portion and sets it in the integration record. Not required for attempt-3 acceptance.

findings.trigger: Run the T13 gate on the canonical Linux checkout, where the generated files materialise with LF.
findings.impact: The new CRLF-normalization line is never exercised by the committed gate: on an LF checkout it is a no-op, so deleting it would not fail any committed test and only a Windows/CRLF checkout would regress to the failure this delta fixes. I reproduced the CRLF path manually (test passes under CRLF, raw bytes differ, a real content mutation still fails), so the determinism guarantee itself is intact; this is a test-coverage advisory about the transport path, not a correctness defect.
findings.required_fix: Optional: extract the comparison into a helper and unit-test it with a CRLF-materialised copy, or add a parametrized case. Not required for V0 acceptance.
